The '''Tracker-4 Military Airspeeder''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] model manufactured by [[Bakur RepulsorCorp]] and issued to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military installations on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. A simple design, it carried light armor plating, a retractable [[transparisteel]] blast shield protecting the crew compartment, and dual fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] with a range of 600 meters. While not competitive with other front-line military airspeeders used by the Imperials or [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], it was more than adequate for dealing with civil unrest on Bakura.<ref name="TABSB" />
